3 /-! The paired triangle images are well defined in the chosen global
4 plane, independently of which orientation names their cut-tree edge. -/
5 
6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
7 
8 open Set
9 
10 namespace RadialStripTriangle
11 
12 /-- Agreement of full surface maps identifies the entire planar triangle image. -/
13 theorem AgreesAfter.image_triangle {P : ConvexPolyhedron}
14     {routes other : C(unitInterval, P.BoundaryCurve)} {p l r q u v : Plane}
15     {D : RadialStripTriangle routes p l r} {E : RadialStripTriangle other q u v}
16     {motion : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane} (agrees : D.AgreesAfter E motion) :
17     motion '' convexHull ℝ ({p, l, r} : Set Plane) = convexHull ℝ ({q, u, v} : Set Plane) := by
18   have included {routes other : C(unitInterval, P.BoundaryCurve)} {p l r q u v : Plane}
19       {D : RadialStripTriangle routes p l r} {E : RadialStripTriangle other q u v}
20       {motion : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane} (agrees : D.AgreesAfter E motion) :
21       motion '' convexHull ℝ ({p, l, r} : Set Plane) ⊆ convexHull ℝ ({q, u, v} : Set Plane) := by
22     rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
23     let b := D.homeomorph.symm ⟨x, hx⟩
24     have other_member : b.val ∈ range (closedRouteStripMap other) := agrees.1 ▸ b.property
25     have same := agrees.2 b.val b.property other_member
26     change motion (D.homeomorph (D.homeomorph.symm ⟨x, hx⟩)) =
27       (E.homeomorph ⟨b.val, other_member⟩ : Plane) at same
28     rw [D.homeomorph.apply_symm_apply] at same
29     exact same.symm ▸ (E.homeomorph ⟨b.val, other_member⟩).property
30   apply Subset.antisymm (included agrees)
31   intro y hy
32   exact ⟨motion.symm y, included agrees.symm ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, motion.apply_symm_apply y⟩
33 
34 end RadialStripTriangle
35 
36 namespace PlacedCutEdgeTriangles
37 
38 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a}
39     {u v w z : T.vertices} {edge : T.graph.Adj u v} {other : T.graph.Adj w z}
40 
41 /-- The union of the two actual placed triangles of a cut edge. -/
42 def kite (D : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge) : Set Plane :=
43   convexHull ℝ ({D.motion D.model.first, D.motion D.model.left, D.motion D.model.right} : Set Plane) ∪
44   convexHull ℝ ({D.motion D.model.second, D.motion D.model.left, D.motion D.model.right} : Set Plane)
45 
46 theorem AgreesAfter.image_kite {D : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge} {E : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T other}
47     {transition : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane} (agrees : D.AgreesAfter E transition) :
48     transition '' D.kite = E.kite := by
49   rw [kite, image_union]
50   rcases agrees with same | swapped
51   · rw [same.1.image_triangle, same.2.image_triangle]
52     rfl
53   · rw [swapped.1.image_triangle, swapped.2.image_triangle, union_comm]
54     rfl
55 
56 /-- Changing the coordinate frame moves the complete paired image by that one motion. -/
57 theorem kite_inFrame (D : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge) (frame : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane) :
58     (D.inFrame frame).kite = frame '' D.kite := by
59   have triangle (p l r : Plane) : frame '' convexHull ℝ ({p, l, r} : Set Plane) =
60       convexHull ℝ ({frame p, frame l, frame r} : Set Plane) := by
61     change frame.toAffineMap '' convexHull ℝ ({p, l, r} : Set Plane) = _
62     rw [frame.toAffineMap.image_convexHull]
63     simp only [image_insert_eq, image_singleton]
64     rfl
65   simp only [kite, image_union, triangle]
66   rfl
67 
68 end PlacedCutEdgeTriangles
69 
70 namespace CutTreeCharts
71 
72 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a} (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
73 
74 /-- The actual kite in the one global plane chosen for the whole tree. -/
75 noncomputable def kite {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) : Set Plane :=
76   ((charts.triangles edge).inFrame (charts.frames.frame u)).kite
77 
78 theorem kite_reverse {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) :
79     charts.kite edge = charts.kite edge.symm := by
80   have same := (charts.frames.global_reversal edge).2.2.image_kite
81   simpa only [AffineIsometryEquiv.coe_refl, image_id] using same
82 
83 /-- At a nonvertex junction the global kite is exactly the image of its fixed fan kite. -/
84 theorem kite_at_fan {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) (nonvertex : (u : Space) ∉ P.vertices) :
85     charts.kite edge = charts.frames.frame u ''
86       ((charts.fan u nonvertex).edgeTriangles edge).developedKite := by
87   unfold kite
88   rw [PlacedCutEdgeTriangles.kite_inFrame, charts.at_fan edge nonvertex]
89   rfl
90 
91 include charts in
92 /-- Every actual internal passage has a flat chart in this fixed collection. -/
93 theorem internal_nonvertex {u v w : T.vertices} (first : T.graph.Adj u v) (second : T.graph.Adj u w)
94     (different : v ≠ w) : (u : Space) ∉ P.vertices := by
95   intro original
96   obtain ⟨q, _, only⟩ := charts.original_leaves u original
97   exact different ((only v first).trans (only w second).symm)
98 
99 /-- The chosen global edge transition swaps the actual roots of the two fixed fans. -/
100 theorem transition_at_fans {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v)
101     (nonvertex_u : (u : Space) ∉ P.vertices) (nonvertex_v : (v : Space) ∉ P.vertices) :
102     let first := charts.fan u nonvertex_u
103     let second := charts.fan v nonvertex_v
104     charts.frames.transition edge first.order.chart.origin = second.order.chart.origin +
105       dist (v : Space) (u : Space) • direction (second.edgeIndex edge.symm) ∧
106     charts.frames.transition edge (first.order.chart.origin +
107       dist (u : Space) (v : Space) • direction (first.edgeIndex edge)) = second.order.chart.origin := by
108   have same := charts.frames.reverses edge
109   rw [charts.at_fan edge nonvertex_u, charts.at_fan edge.symm nonvertex_v] at same
110   let D := (charts.fan u nonvertex_u).edgeTriangles edge
111   let E := (charts.fan v nonvertex_v).edgeTriangles edge.symm
112   have left : charts.frames.transition edge (D.motion D.model.left) = E.motion E.model.right := same.1
113   have right : charts.frames.transition edge (D.motion D.model.right) = E.motion E.model.left := same.2.1
114   rw [D.at_junction, E.at_neighbor] at left
115   rw [D.at_neighbor, E.at_junction] at right
116   exact ⟨left, right⟩
117 
118 end CutTreeCharts
119 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
